evidence_snippet: The Master of Human-Computer Interaction (MHCI) program at Carnegie Mellon University is the first program in the world dedicated to preparing professionals for careers related to human-computer interaction, user experience design and user-centered research.
The MHCI program integrates service and design thinking into a rigorous HCI curriculum that prepares students to design and guide the future of human and technology interactions.

The University of Washington's Master of Science in Human Centered Design & Engineering (HCDE) prepares its graduates for leadership roles in user experience research and design, interface design, interaction design, product design, and human-computer interaction.
HCDE Master's students solve real-world problems with interdisciplinary faculty and courses are offered in-person and cannot be completed online.
Welcome to the Master’s Program in Human-Computer Interaction.

The MS-HCI Program at Georgia Tech empowers students with both practical skills and theoretical knowledge, positioning them as industry leaders in the design, implementation, and evaluation of the next generation of human-computer interfaces.
With a Master of Professional Studies (MPS) in information science, you'll tackle real-world problems and design a tailored curriculum that prepares you for careers at leading companies.
Four optional focus areas offer specialized training in user experience, data science, interactive technologies, and networks, crowds, and markets.
Research areas include Human-computer Interaction (HCI) and User Experience Research.

Every MIMS student charts their own path. Whether you want to be an AI engineer, product designer, data scientist, or tech policy leader, you’ll tailor your coursework and projects to fit your ambitions.
